_about: Page themes for the lab instructions, like the event Backgrounds. A course picks one in labs/registry.json (console › Student view › Theme). colors: header = the band at the top (white text on it), header_accent = the colored words in the header, link = links, button = buttons and the first flag stripe (white text on it), highlight = the second flag stripe and focus outline. pattern = optional SVG shapes drawn faintly on the header (a 120 × 120 tile, white lines). The build checks every color's contrast and falls back to the default if one is hard to read. The 'ung' theme has no colors: pages keep the colors they were approved with.
